sn37.10:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti.
sn37.10:1.3: assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottāpī ca hoti, dussīlo ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti.
sn37.10:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti.
